title: Monthly Support to food & medicine
summary: As part of its ongoing commitment to community service, Prabhat Roadways donated ₹5,000 towards the monthly food and medicine expenses of the residents at Karuneshwar Charitable Trust.
description:
As part of its ongoing commitment to community service, Prabhat Roadways donated ₹5,000 towards the monthly food and medicine expenses of the residents at Karuneshwar Charitable Trust.

The contribution helped support the daily nutritional and healthcare needs of 43 beneficiaries, ensuring they receive proper meals and essential medicines with dignity and care.
